Audit Log Entry

An audit log entry is identified by its name and is related to optionally a citation and optionally an app user (its actor).

ƒ Name Calculated 1 hop from ground truth string DR-9
In RuleSpeak® ⚠︎ mechanical

An audit log entry's name is computed as the lower-cased “audit-”, followed by the citation, followed by a hyphen, followed by the timestamp formatted as “YYYY-MM-DDTHH-mm-ss”, followed by a hyphen, followed by the action type with every a space replaced by a hyphen.

In plain words

((((("audit-" joined with citation) joined with "-") joined with datetime_format(timestamp, "YYYY-MM-DDTHH-mm-ss")) joined with "-") joined with action type) with “ ” replaced by “-” lowercased.

As a formula
= LOWER(SUBSTITUTE("audit-" & Citation & "-" & DATETIME_FORMAT(Timestamp, "YYYY-MM-DDTHH-mm-ss") & "-" & Action Type, " ", "-"))
Inputs 3 fields this rule reads
⇢CitationAudit Log Entry FK to the Citation this audit entry concerns. ●TimestampAudit Log Entry When the action occurred. ●Action TypeAudit Log Entry STATUS_CHANGE | field-edit | OVERRIDE | review-decision | recommendation-change | SUBMISSION | hard-stop-block.
Ground truth at the leaves 3 the raw values this ultimately depends on
⇢ Citation Audit Log Entry ● Timestamp Audit Log Entry ● Action Type Audit Log Entry

Logical key.

⇢ Citation Relationship string

A pointer to Citation. It is not derived from anything else — it is the link the rest of the DAG hangs off.

ƒ Is Override Action Calculated 1 hop from ground truth boolean DR-10
In RuleSpeak®

The audit log entry's is override action is determined by the following priority:

  1. true if the action type, followed by an empty string is “override”
  2. false in all other cases
In plain words

If (action type joined with "") lowercased is "override" then true(), otherwise false().

As a formula
= IF(LOWER(Action Type & "") = "override", TRUE(), FALSE())
Inputs 1 fields this rule reads
●Action TypeAudit Log Entry STATUS_CHANGE | field-edit | OVERRIDE | review-decision | recommendation-change | SUBMISSION | hard-stop-block.
Ground truth at the leaves 1 the raw values this ultimately depends on

Calculated flag — TRUE when this audit log entry represents a manager override action (vs a routine action).

ƒ Depth Calculated 1 hop from ground truth integer DR-31
In RuleSpeak® ⚠︎ mechanical

The platform naviation's depth is determined by the following priority:

  1. 0 if the parent route key is blank
  2. the length of the route key minus the length of the route key with every a period replaced by an empty string in all other cases
In plain words

If parent route key equals blank() then 0, otherwise (the length of route key minus the length of route key with “.” replaced by “”).

As a formula
= IF(Parent Route Key=BLANK(), 0, LEN(Route Key) - LEN(SUBSTITUTE(Route Key, ".", "")))
Inputs 2 fields this rule reads
●Parent Route KeyPlatform Naviation Route key of parent nav node (empty for top-level) ●Route KeyPlatform Naviation Stable dot-delimited slug, e.g. checklists.score
Ground truth at the leaves 2 the raw values this ultimately depends on
● Parent Route Key Platform Naviation ● Route Key Platform Naviation

Calculated — nesting depth in the menu tree. 0 = top-level (no parent); otherwise the number of dot-segments in the dotted RouteKey above the root (e.g. 'library.rules.detail' = 2). Drives N-deep indentation.

ƒ Handler Base Name Calculated 1 hop from ground truth string DR-33
In RuleSpeak® ⚠︎ mechanical

A platform naviation's handler base name is computed as the route key with every a period replaced by a space with every a hyphen replaced by a space.

In plain words

Route key with “.” replaced by “ ” with “-” replaced by “ ”.

As a formula
= SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(Route Key, ".", " "), "-", " ")
Inputs 1 fields this rule reads
●Route KeyPlatform Naviation Stable dot-delimited slug, e.g. checklists.score
Ground truth at the leaves 1 the raw values this ultimately depends on
● Route Key Platform Naviation

Calculated — space-delimited form of the dotted RouteKey (dots and hyphens become spaces), e.g. 'library rules detail'. The client PascalCases this and prefixes the viewer role to derive the handler component deterministically: {Role} + PascalCase(HandlerBaseName) -> e.g. AdminLibraryRulesDetail, RepresentativeLibraryRulesDetail. No per-role handler is stored; edge cases get their own single-role route row instead.

ƒ Urgency Bucket Calculated 2 hops from ground truth string DR-72
In RuleSpeak®

The work queue item's urgency bucket is determined by the following priority:

  1. “follow-up” if the due in days is blank
  2. “urgent” if the due in days is at most 0
  3. “due-3-days” if the due in days is at most 3
  4. “upcoming” in all other cases
In plain words

If due in days equals blank() then "follow-up", otherwise if due in days is at most 0 then "urgent", otherwise if due in days is at most 3 then "due-3-days", otherwise "upcoming".

As a formula
= IF(Due in Days=BLANK(),"follow-up",IF(Due in Days<=0,"urgent",IF(Due in Days<=3,"due-3-days","upcoming")))

ƒ Admin Can Create Calculated 1 hop from ground truth boolean DR-110
In RuleSpeak®

The ERB table's admin can create is determined by the following priority:

  1. no value if the admin CRUD is blank
  2. the admin CRUD mentions “C” in all other cases
In plain words

If admin CRUD equals blank() then blank(), otherwise not find("C", admin CRUD) has an error.

As a formula
= IF(Admin CRUD=BLANK(),BLANK(),NOT(ISERROR(FIND("C",Admin CRUD))))
Inputs 1 fields this rule reads
●Admin CRUDERB Table Admin CRUD grant for this table (contains C/R/U/D). NULL inherits Roles.DefaultCRUD for Admin.

Derived: AdminCRUD contains 'C' (BLANK when AdminCRUD is NULL = inherits role default).

In RuleSpeak®

The citation's contest status is determined by the following priority:

  1. “NotContested” if the contest requested flag is not set
  2. “HearingRequested” if the count of hearings is 0
  3. “Scheduled” if any of these hold:
    • the latest hearing outcome is “Pending”
    • the latest hearing outcome is blank
  4. “Heard” in all other cases
In plain words

If not contest requested then "NotContested", otherwise if count of hearings equals 0 then "HearingRequested", otherwise if latest hearing outcome is "Pending" or latest hearing outcome is blank then "Scheduled", otherwise "Heard".

As a formula
= IF(NOT(Contest Requested), "NotContested", IF(Count of Hearings = 0, "HearingRequested", IF(OR(Latest Hearing Outcome = "Pending", ISBLANK(Latest Hearing Outcome)), "Scheduled", "Heard")))
Inputs 3 fields this rule reads

● Outcome Hearing ⇢ Citation Hearing ● Citation Number Citation ● Scheduled for Hearing ● Responded on Citation ● As of Date Citation ● Issued on Citation ● Days to Respond Jurisdiction ⇢ Jurisdiction Citation ● Jurisdiction ID Jurisdiction ● Contest Requested Citation ● Points Violation Type ⇢ Violation Type Citation ● Violation Type ID Violation Type

License points this citation actually contributes to the driver: the violation's points if the driver is liable and not dismissed, otherwise 0. Drives the driver's ActivePoints rollup.

ƒ Citation Status Calculated 4 hops from ground truth string DR-186
In RuleSpeak®

The citation's citation status is determined by the following priority:

  1. “Closed” if any of these hold:
    • the paid on has a value
    • the dismissed flag is set
  2. “Adjudicated” if any of these hold:
    • the latest hearing outcome is “Guilty”
    • the latest hearing outcome is “Upheld”
    • all of these hold:
      • the response overdue flag is set
      • the contest requested flag is not set
  3. “InContest” if all of these hold:
    • the contest requested flag is set
    • the count of hearings is greater than 0
  4. “Responded” if the responded on has a value
  5. “Issued” in all other cases
In plain words

If not paid on is blank or is dismissed then "Closed", otherwise if latest hearing outcome is "Guilty", latest hearing outcome is "Upheld", or is response overdue and not contest requested then "Adjudicated", otherwise if contest requested and count of hearings is greater than 0 then "InContest", otherwise if not responded on is blank then "Responded", otherwise "Issued".

As a formula
= IF(OR(NOT(ISBLANK(Paid on)), Is Dismissed), "Closed", IF(OR(Latest Hearing Outcome = "Guilty", Latest Hearing Outcome = "Upheld", AND(Is Response Overdue, NOT(Contest Requested))), "Adjudicated", IF(AND(Contest Requested, Count of Hearings > 0), "InContest", IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Responded on)), "Responded", "Issued"))))
Inputs 7 fields this rule reads
●Paid onCitation Date the fine was paid in full. Null if not yet paid. ƒIs DismissedCitation True when latest hearing outcome is "Dismissed". ΣLatest Hearing OutcomeCitation Largest outcome across all hearings whose citation is this one and scheduled for is largest scheduled for across all hearings whose citation is this one. ƒIs Response OverdueCitation True when responded on is blank and as of date is greater than response due date. ●Contest RequestedCitation Whether the driver elected to contest the citation (request a hearing) rather than pay. ΣCount of HearingsCitation Count of hearings whose citation is this one. ●Responded onCitation Date the driver responded (paid or requested a hearing). Null if no response yet.
Ground truth at the leaves 12 the raw values this ultimately depends on
● Paid on Citation ● Outcome Hearing ⇢ Citation Hearing ● Citation Number Citation ● Scheduled for Hearing ● Responded on Citation ● As of Date Citation ● Issued on Citation ● Days to Respond Jurisdiction ⇢ Jurisdiction Citation ● Jurisdiction ID Jurisdiction ● Contest Requested Citation

Citation lifecycle state machine: Issued -> Responded -> InContest -> Adjudicated -> Closed. The top-level status synthesizing the other tracks.
